_meta.purpose: AXE-EXP-1 (a11y axe audit, e2e/a11y-axe-authenticated.spec.ts) — accepted pre-existing violation rule IDs per authorized QA-harness route:theme key. The gate fails on NEW rules and on stale entries (findings that no longer reproduce must be removed from this file — the baseline must shrink, not rot).
_meta.policy: Adding a rule here requires a documented justification. FORBIDDEN: adding a rule to make a failing audit pass without justification (Rule 13 analog). Every entry is a PRE-EXISTING finding first baselined at AXE-EXP-1 (probe on main aca7d96a8, 02.09.2026, 34 audits, 236 nodes); the shrink-only ratchet stays in force across the AXE-EXP track.
_meta.scope: Authorized QA-harness surfaces only (e2e/support/authenticatedQa.ts): 6 role homes (admin/registrar/doctor/cashier/lab/patient) + 2 specialty surfaces (doctor-cardiology, doctor-dermatology ?tab=appointments) + 9 admin-family routes × light/dark = 34 audits. Public routes are covered by e2e/a11y-baseline.json (empty after the CC track).
_meta.resolution: AXE-EXP-2 (app-chrome inks): chrome class → --mac-text-on-tertiary. AXE-EXP-3 (badge fills): Badge/MacOSTab white-ink fills → CC-2 strong tokens; info tint → constant dark-blue ink. AXE-EXP-4 (tab/link inks): SegmentedControl inactive segments + patient .pp-tab inactive → on-tertiary ink; patient .pp-tab-active link → new canonical --mac-link-ink token (light #0066d6 = accent-strong, dark #5ac8fa — the CC-2-documented deferred link-ink latent class); lab .lqw-status-filter-btn-active → strong fill; .lqw-sort-label → on-tertiary; 3 admin tertiary utility classes → secondary ink. color-contrast now remains on ONE key only (admin-services:dark — a distinct root cause: --mac-card-bg/--mac-main-shell-bg have no dark values, so DataTable surfaces render light in dark theme; tracked for its own increment). Remaining ARIA rules = AXE-EXP-5.
_meta.probe_diagnosis: Original seeding (AXE-EXP-1): 236 violation nodes / 34 audits — 200 color-contrast + 36 ARIA (aria-required-parent 22 MacOSTab; aria-valid-attr-value 6 SegmentedControl; aria-required-children 4 AppointmentSummaryBar; aria-prohibited-attr 2 admin-kpi-grid; label 2 cashier date input). After AXE-EXP-2 (chrome) + EXP-3 (badges) + EXP-4 (tab/link inks): 38 nodes remain (2 color-contrast on the card-bg dark-hole + 36 ARIA).
